title: fix(spec)!: defineStack judges a record:line_items column that declares no type as the type it renders (#24190)
body:
Fixes #24190

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

`defineStack`'s resolved-type check, `collectHydratedInlineColumnErrors` in `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`, now walks the fourth carrier of the inline grid column: a `record:line_items` page block's `columns`. A column that declares no `type` is judged as the type it renders, against the field of the child object the panel lists, with the column schema's own refusal (`STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID`, 422). Today that refuses `scale` on an identity-only column over a `currency` child field. The same column now gets the same answer under `record:line_items` and under `object-master-detail-form`.

## What changed

- **`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`.** The page walk (the shared `forEachPageComponent` traversal) judges a `record:line_items` node's `columns` with the same per-column `judge` the other three carriers use. The location reads `Page 'NAME' (PATH) record:line_items columns[K].KEY`. A new helper, `lineItemsChildObject`, resolves the child object the way the renderer does (below). The function's docblock lists four carriers instead of "All three carriers" (rider i from `6236510990`). Its line-items bullet names the positions the walk visits (a region's components, a container's component children, a slot) and says a block under a `page:tabs` item's `children` is not yet visited (patch round 1, contract review `6251625691` item ① 9). The `forEachPageComponent` docblock and the call-site comment name the new user.
- **`packages/spec/src/inline-grid-column-carriers.test.ts`.** The line-items section's "pinned on purpose" note is gone (rider ii). The CONTROL test "defineStack does not judge an identity-only line-items column" is flipped into a PARITY test: for the same columns, the line-items block and the master-detail block both refuse with `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID` / 422, one finding each, and the finding text past its location is byte-identical. New cases: refusal on a region, inside a container, under a slot; the object `dataSource` binding wins over `childObject` (both directions); an API binding falls back to `childObject`; a column invalid on its own is left to the props half; controls; an unresolved child object (undeclared, or none) is not judged; the remedy builds. The refusal cases assert the envelope (`code`, `status`), the located subject, the column name, the child field's type (`field 'crm_invoice_line.amount' is \`currency\``) and the ruled first sentence.
- **`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`.** TSDoc only, on `RecordLineItemsProps`. Its paragraph said the check "walks the three master-detail carriers and not this block", which this change makes false. It also said the panel draws untyped columns as text "until the `.objectui-sha` pin carries" objectui#12854. The pin carries it now (see G2). No schema, key or `.describe()` changes. Measured: this TSDoc block is not emitted into `packages/spec/dist/*.d.ts` (zero hits for the old or the new text after the build), so it ships no bytes.
- **`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-record-line-items-props-closed.ts`.** Text only, no id, conversion or matcher change. Its `reason` said "`defineStack`'s identity-only column check does not reach this block", which this change makes false. Its `replacement` said "this block draws a column exactly as declared and hydrates nothing from the child object's field", which contradicts the refusal this change adds. The entry now states the identity-only reach in its surface, replacement, reason and acceptance criteria, in the words the `object-master-detail-form` entry uses for the same reach, plus this change's population census. Patch round 1 (item ① 9): its `reason` names the three positions the walk visits and says a block under a `page:tabs` item's `children` is not yet judged, instead of "wherever a page carries it" (no tracker number in that author-facing text). The census notes that the showcase project detail block sits under a `page:tabs` item.
- **`packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template`** (patch round 1, contract review `6251625691` item ① 8). Text only. `id` and `order` are unchanged, and so is the list's shape (`step18-rationale-merge.test.ts`). The `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment `ui-record-line-items-props-closed` (order 57) said the panel draws its columns "with no hydration from the child object's field, so `defineStack`'s identity-only check does not reach it". The upgrade guide prints that fragment just above this entry's `reason`, and `objectstack migrate meta` prints it too. It now states the reach the way the master-detail fragment (order 56) states its own: the panel hydrates an untyped column from the child field, so the identity-only check reaches the block, against the child object the panel lists, in a page region's components, a container's component children and a slot. It also says a block under a `page:tabs` item's `children` is not yet judged. `gen:migration-registry` regenerates the gitignored `registry.ts`; nothing else to commit.
- **`.changeset/24190-line-items-hydrated-check.md`.** `@objectstack/spec` `minor`, the `!` title shape, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, a FROM → TO table and the one-line fix. Its `defineStack` bullet names the three positions the walk reaches and the `page:tabs` exclusion (patch round 1, item ① 9). Its ADR-0087 disposition is `not-required (already-registered ui-record-line-items-props-closed)`: the entry pre-dates the merge base, and this diff makes its text cover this change.

## Measured before editing (`origin/main` `ec749fbb44`)

- **G1.** `collectHydratedInlineColumnErrors` was at `stack.zod.ts:3576` and the "All three carriers" sentence at `:3560`. The "pinned on purpose" note was at `inline-grid-column-carriers.test.ts:615`–`:620` and the CONTROL test at `:740`. All matched.
- **G2, the precondition.** `.objectui-sha` is `0707b4ae37120d45d6401170666a0b76cb7a3546`. In the objectui clone, `git merge-base --is-ancestor 54e79f989 0707b4ae3712` exits 0. Exit 0 proves ancestry in any checkout, so no control leg is owed (control leg run anyway: the pin's 60th ancestor, `e43a16207`, also exits 0). At the pin, `packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx` hands `hydrateColumns(schema.columns, childSchema, …)` to the grid. That is the same `hydrateColumns` from `deriveMasterDetail.ts` the master-detail carriers call. `childSchema` is `dataSource.getObjectSchema(schema.childObject)`.
- **G3, how the panel names its child object.** There is no relationship-field lookup. The panel reads `schema.childObject`, and its registration (`packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx`, `RECORD_LINE_ITEMS_DATA_SOURCE = { object: 'childObject', … }`) wraps it in `ElementDataSourceGate`. When the node carries an object `dataSource` binding (a plain object with a non-empty string `object`, `isElementDataSourceConfig`), the gate writes the binding's `object` onto `childObject` over the authored one (`next[objectKey] = composed.object`, "binding wins" in `element-data-source.ts`). An API binding (`provider: 'api'`) is not such a config, so the panel reads `properties.childObject` as authored. `lineItemsChildObject` follows the same order. This differs from the master-detail block, which has only `details[].childObject`. The spec declares both channels: `RecordLineItemsProps.childObject` is optional "because the component-level `dataSource` binding can supply the object instead", and its docblock says the block's mapping writes the binding's `object` onto `childObject`. So this is the declared precedence, not a consumer-side fallback.
- **G4, who authors these columns.** Two blocks in `examples/app-showcase`: `project-detail.page.ts` (five typed columns) and `invoice-document.page.ts` (four `{ name, label }` columns, two of them over `currency` fields). One in `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` (four `{ name }` columns). None carries `scale`, and `scale` is the only type-conditional column key today. So no shipped example, skill or fixture is refused by the new check.

## Shapes left unjudged

Each of these follows the function's own rule, "an unresolved column is not a wrong one":

- a child object this stack does not declare: another package's object, or a binding that names one;
- a block with neither `childObject` nor an object binding (the panel shows its configuration hint and draws nothing);
- **a block inside a `page:tabs` item's `children`.** `forEachPageComponent` recurses only into arrays under `properties` whose entries are components. A `page:tabs` item `{ value, label, children }` is not a component, so the walk never reaches the components under it. Probe through `defineStack` on this branch: the same refused column is ACCEPTED under a `page:tabs` item for both `record:line_items` and `object-master-detail-form`. An inline action with a dangling modal target is ACCEPTED there too, while all three are REFUSED at region level. The showcase project detail page's `record:line_items` sits exactly there. This blind spot is in the shared traversal, so it reaches every check that uses it, not only this card's walk. It is the subject of #24349 and is not changed here, because widening the traversal also narrows the inline-action check. This PR's shipped sentences name only the positions the walk visits. The sibling master-detail text on `main` (its step-18 rationale fragment and entry) carries the same "wherever a page carries it" claim and is also left to #24349.

## Tests

All runs are on the final head `ced64a4af` (patch round 1 on top of `af540b850`, which is this branch with `origin/main` `68a090fb9` merged), through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`. Patch round 1 also ran `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:migration-registry` ("wrote src/migrations/registry.ts (475 semantic, 269 retired-key, 224 retired-def)") and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --project repo scripts/step18-rationale-merge.test.ts` (`Tests 9 passed (9)`). It ran `pnpm check:doc-authoring` (exit 0, "19013 customer-facing string(s) across 1429 spec sources clean"), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:upgrade-guide` (exit 0) and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:spec-changes` (exit 0). The built `packages/spec/dist/migrations/index.js` carries the new fragment, and the old "does not reach it" sentence is gone. Each reading in the list below was re-taken on `ced64a4af`. The ablation after the list is the round-1 reading on `c07bb2cc8`; this round changed no code line it mutated (only a docblock in `stack.zod.ts`):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/inline-grid-column-carriers.test.ts`: `Tests 52 passed (52)`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit`, `check:scripts-typecheck`, and `check:test-typecheck: OK`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2` (the whole `local` project): `Test Files 694 passed (694)`, `Tests 21050 passed | 1 todo (21051)`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date" after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`. Nothing was regenerated and the tree is clean.
- `test:repo` (the vitest `repo` project) was not run locally. It belongs to CI's `Test Core`.

**Ablation**, one behaviour at a time, with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit, blob hash moves, restore proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`). The test imports `./stack.zod` relatively, so it reads source and no `dist/` leg applies.

1. The anchor `if (node.type === 'record:line_items') {` was replaced with a type no node carries. Expected and observed direction: RED. `Tests 5 failed | 47 passed (52)`. The PARITY test, the region, container and slot refusals, the binding test and the API-binding test failed, and every control stayed green. Restored: blob `9f842c19fe4c` == HEAD.
2. `const binding = node.dataSource;` was replaced with `undefined`. RED, `1 failed | 51 passed`: only the binding-precedence test failed. Restored: blob == HEAD.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) was run at `ced64a4af` and derives 92 commands, the same 92 as at `af540b850`. All 92 were run locally, each exit code captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconciliation: "92 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 91 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".

- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. Reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because it reads every package's `dist/` (92 packages unbuilt in this worktree). That is a full-monorepo build, which belongs to CI.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` and `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure` read built `formula`, `lint` and `objectql`. Those were built before the run (`turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint --filter=@objectstack/objectql --concurrency=2`), and both gates exited 0 inside it.
- `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 0, ".changeset/24190-line-items-hydrated-check.md [BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (already-registered)".
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 0. Its level axis was NOT APPLICABLE locally ("no `pull_request` payload"), so CI's run on this PR reads the `Clause-②` line above.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:api-surface`: "public API surface + factory signatures unchanged". `pnpm check:nul-bytes`: OK.

## Acceptance notes

- **Contract-tier review before the queue.** This narrows what `defineStack` / `objectstack validate` publish, so it owes one review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, per triage's grade `6238078348`.
- **Stale comments outside this card's file surface, not changed.** `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/invoice-document.page.ts` (the comment above its `record:line_items` columns) says the block "does not fill a column from the child field, so an identity-only `{ name }` column prints its raw field name". `examples/app-showcase/test/invoice-document-line-items.test.ts` (its header) says the block "draws a column exactly as declared". Both stopped being true when the console pin took objectui#12854, not because of this change. Comment-only, owned by nobody: no card.
- **The `page:tabs` traversal blind spot** (above) is #24349.
- The three text edits outside the claim's listed file surface (the `RecordLineItemsProps` TSDoc, the step-18 migration entry, and, in patch round 1, its `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment in `registry.ts.template`) are fixes of sentences this change makes false. None changes a schema, a key, an id, an order or a conversion.
